features.statement: Page uses a styled magazine-style layout with a centered container and a right sidebar column beside the main content.
Body text and UI use a sans-serif (Helvetica Neue) while headings use a serif (Georgia), giving a two-family pairing.
Body text has generous line height of about 1.55 relative to a 16px base size.
Category labels are small, uppercase, letter-spaced accent-colored text placed above titles.
Article titles are bold serif text without underlines, rather than underlined default links.
Page background is a warm off-white cream rather than pure white.
Body text is near-black navy rather than medium gray, giving strong contrast.
A single burnt-orange accent color is used for labels, underlines, borders and badges.
Warm beige-gray is used for borders and fills, alongside white card surfaces, forming a muted neutral palette.
Main navigation is a horizontal bar of text links with white background and bottom border, possibly sticky.
A small pill-shaped accent badge (e.g. 'TRENDING') labels a featured headline in the top bar.
Logo is scaled down and centered in the header.
Page opens with a hero: large featured image with big serif headline and excerpt, beside a list of small thumbnail posts.
Post sections use multi-column card grids (2 or 3 columns) with consistent image sizes and image above title.
Section headings have a short accent underline under the text, a full-width dark rule, and a right-aligned 'View all →' link.
Text-only posts appear as white cards with an accent-colored left border.
Sidebar consists of bordered white widget cards, each with a serif heading and accent underline.
Author photo is cropped to a circle with name and role text beneath it.
All images carry descriptive alt text, with none missing.
Footer is a dark navy band with multiple columns: brand blurb and link lists.
Each post is wrapped in an article element, with no figure or figcaption wrappers.
Page is self-contained with a single inline style block and no external scripts or stylesheets.
Heading hierarchy is clean: starts at h1, h2 for sections, lower levels for sidebar widgets.
Markup is compact with few divs and few unique classes.
Cards and images use small corner radii (1–7px), with only rare pill shapes.
Sidebar list items are separated by thin horizontal hairline dividers instead of bullet markers.
Excerpts appear between title and byline in gray sans-serif; byline is small gray text under titles.
Search field uses concise microcopy: placeholder 'Search articles…' and a short 'Go' button.
Separation relies on thin 1px borders and hairlines, with no box-shadows, transitions or gradients.
Card grids have uneven card heights and orphaned cells when post count is odd.
